basic_info.description: Located in the historic Bayview neighborhood of San Francisco, this charming and well maintained single-family home at 1547 McKinnon, is the perfect place to craft your dream home.  This gorgeous property has been meticulously cared for and features 1,432 sq ft of inviting living space. Natural light pours in through the windows and skylights of the open layout, creating a warm and airy atmosphere as a blank canvas for your creative vision.  The backyard offers a private garden sanctuary filled with fruit trees and open space ready for hosting.  The desirable location offers quick and easy access to downtown SF via the Muni line, as well as a short drive to SFO airport.  The neighborhood is home to local cafes, restaurants, shops and creative spaces just a short walk away.  Whether you're spending a sunny afternoon working from home or exploring what's around the corner, this property offers both comfort and convenience.    OPEN SAT 8/16 & SUN 8/17 2-4PM
